name: @puna/sdk-frontend
description: Plugin SDK — frontend slot helpers, registry loader, PluginHostProvider.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun run build:js && bun run build:types
scripts.build:js: bun build ./src/index.ts ./src/slots.tsx ./src/host.tsx ./src/registry.ts ./src/loader.ts ./src/badge.tsx --outdir dist --target browser --format esm --production --external react --external react-dom --external react/jsx-runtime --external react-dom/client --external @tanstack/react-router --external @puna/sdk-shared
